- [Readme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notifly-tech/notifly-gtm-template/main/README.md): README describing how to locally import and test the Notifly Google Tag Manager tag template (`template.tpl`) within a GTM web container via the Templates UI, including the required steps to load, import, save, and use the template.
- [Template.ko](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notifly-tech/notifly-gtm-template/main/template.ko.tpl): Defines the Notifly JavaScript SDK Google Tag Manager tag template, configuring UI parameters and permissions, loading `notifly-js-sdk` via `injectScript`, and invoking `notifly.initialize`, `setUserId`, `setUserProperties`, or `trackEvent` based on the selected tag type.
- [Template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notifly-tech/notifly-gtm-template/main/template.tpl): Google Tag Manager custom template that injects the Notifly JS SDK from jsDelivr and, based on the `type` parameter, calls `notifly.initialize`, `setUserId`, `setUserProperties`, or `trackEvent` with GTM-provided configuration, enforcing version regex and required initialization fields.
